channel.title: Diffasaurus Preview Updates
channel.description: Preview channel appcast for Diffasaurus macOS builds.

item.title: Diffasaurus 0.2.0 Preview 5
item.description:
Diffasaurus 0.2.0 Preview 5

  • Sparkle-based macOS self-update bootstrap for the preview channel.
  • Native Check for Updates… menu action.
  • EdDSA-verified update archives before extraction.
  • Session restore across update and relaunch.
  • Entity search by any name token, including reversed multi-token queries.
  • Immediate autocomplete selection in Entity History and Point-in-Time.
  • Deduplicated autocomplete results (one row per account).

Preview 4 users should install Preview 5 manually. Preview 5 can then update to Preview 6 and later in-app.
